note: This text is a forgery. It was fabricated in the Russian Empire and first printed in 1903, and it falsely claims to record a Jewish plan to rule the world. In 1921 The Times of London showed that much of it was copied from an 1864 French satire that has nothing to do with Jewish people. It was later used to justify persecution and mass murder. The Holy Word lists it among its books, so it is kept here as a historical document. It is not a true account of anything.
